body.purpose: Reading copy: sector summary, hero subhead, news headlines, stock blurbs.

label.purpose: Every number, ticker, timestamp, and uppercase short label. Doubles as the tabular-nums numeric voice.

shadows.name: toast-float
shadows.purpose: The only permitted drop shadow — the transient toast overlay.

shadows.name: live-status-halo
shadows.purpose: Soft ring around the live-status dot when data.json is real, not demo.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for hover/focus/active state changes on buttons, chips, rows, inputs.

motion.name: ticker-scroll
motion.purpose: Continuous, calm ticker-tape scroll; pauses on hover; disabled (falls back to manual overflow-x scroll) under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The only button variant in use (e.g. 'Instalar app'). Pill radius, transparent fill, navy on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.82rem; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c5cdbc); background: transparent; color: var(--text, #1c231d); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #2d4a6b); color: var(--accent, #2d4a6b); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2d4a6b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Default (unselected) filter chip. Monospace uppercase label, transparent fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c5cdbc); background: transparent; color: var(--text-dim, #5c6a5c); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease, background 0.12s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--text, #1c231d); border-color: var(--accent, #2d4a6b); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2d4a6b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip — Active
components.description: Selected filter chip. The only place a chip becomes a filled solid-navy surface.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2d4a6b); background: var(--accent, #2d4a6b); color: var(--panel, #ffffff); cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Sentiment Badge
components.description: Pill badge at ~10% tint of the semantic color; used for sector sentiment, per-stock tags, and news dots. bullish/bearish/mixed modifiers shown.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.63rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-badge--bullish { color: var(--rise, #2f7a4f); background: rgba(47,122,79,0.1); } .ds-badge--bearish { color: var(--fall, #a13a2f); background: rgba(161,58,47,0.1); } .ds-badge--mixed { color: var(--mixed, #8a7233); background: rgba(138,114,51,0.1); }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: Signature component. One row of the stock table: ticker/name/blurb, tabular-nums price and change, sparkline, sentiment tag — sharing a fixed column grid with the table header.
components.html:
NVDANVIDIA
$128.45
+3.2%
Alcista
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(150px,1.6fr) 70px 60px 90px 80px; gap: 16px; align-items: center; padding: 18px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dde3d6); transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-ledger-row:hover { background: var(--panel-raised, #f6f9f2); } .ds-ledger-id { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-ledger-ticker { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-ledger-name { font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--text-faint, #8b9789); } .ds-ledger-price { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; } .ds-ledger-change { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; } .ds-ledger-change--up { color: var(--rise, #2f7a4f); } .ds-ledger-change--down { color: var(--fall, #a13a2f); } .ds-ledger-spark { width: 100%; height: 36px; } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.63rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-badge--bullish { color: var(--rise, #2f7a4f); background: rgba(47,122,79,0.1); }

components.name: News Row
components.description: One row of the news list: rounded-square status dot, headline + source/time meta, bracketed monospace ticker tag. Quieter than the ledger row — no pill tag.
components.html:
NVIDIA supera expectativas de ingresos

Reuters · hace 2 h
[NVDA]
components.css: .ds-news-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 16px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dde3d6); } .ds-news-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-news-dot--up { background: var(--rise, #2f7a4f); } .ds-news-dot--down { background: var(--fall, #a13a2f); } .ds-news-body { min-width: 0; } .ds-news-headline { font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 4px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-news-meta { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-faint, #8b9789); } .ds-news-tag { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-dim, #5c6a5c); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The one text input in the system. Sharp 4px radius (input language, not pill language).
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="Buscar empresa o ticker…">
components.css: .ds-input { font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c5cdbc); background: var(--panel, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #1c231d); min-width: 220px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #2d4a6b); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-faint, #8b9789); }

components.name: Ticker Tape Item
components.description: Signature component. One symbol/price/change entry in the continuously scrolling ticker tape, separated by hairline rules.
components.css: .ds-ticker-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 9px; padding: 11px 24px; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; border-right: 1px solid var(--line, #dde3d6); color: var(--text-dim, #5c6a5c); } .ds-ticker-symbol { color: var(--text, #1c231d); font-weight: 700; } .ds-ticker-change--up { color: var(--rise, #2f7a4f); } .ds-ticker-change--down { color: var(--fall, #a13a2f); }

narrative.overview:
A calm, considered instrument for reading the AI stocks sector — not another black AI-dashboard clone with a purple-to-teal glow, and not generic glossy abstract art either (both were tried and explicitly rejected during this project). The system borrows its materiality from the accounting ledger — pale sage paper, near-black ink, red ink for losses — and its discipline from a financial terminal: tabular numbers, a real ticker tape, a real composite chart. Nothing performs; everything reports.

The system is deliberately single-theme (light only). A ledger page doesn't have a dark mode any more than a terminal has a light one — committing to one world was a conscious choice, not an omission.
keyCharacteristics: Pale sage-green paper background, never pure white or black
One accent color (fountain-pen navy) reserved for brand/interactive moments only
A separate, distinct semantic triad (green/red/ochre) for rise/fall/mixed — never reuses the accent hue
Two deliberate type voices: a plain sans for reading, a tracked-out monospace for every number and label
Flat surfaces, hairline dividers, real data visualizations instead of decorative imagery

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Fountain-Pen Navy is the only brand accent on the page. It never appears twice for two different reasons in the same view — if a color is doing semantic work (rise/fall/mixed), it is never navy.

rules.name: The No-Black Rule
rules.body: No #000000 and no #ffffff stands alone as a surface without the sage bias — even "white" panels sit on sage paper, and "black" text carries a green undertone.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: If it's read, it's the sans. If it's a number, a ticker, or a short label, it's the tracked-out monospace. Never mix the two within a single value.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Elevation is earned only by things that are genuinely temporary or floating above the page (the toast). A permanent, in-flow element never gets a drop shadow — use a hairline or a tonal shift instead.

rules.name: The Two-Radius Rule
rules.body: If it's something you click or a status you read, it's a pill (999px). If it's something you read data inside of, it's 4px. No third radius.

dos: Do keep the accent (Fountain-Pen Navy) exclusive to brand/interactive moments — never reuse it for rise/fall/mixed semantics.
Do run every number, ticker, and short label through the monospace label voice with tabular-nums; keep sentences in the sans.
Do use hairlines and tonal shifts for hierarchy and depth; reach for the toast's shadow only for genuinely floating, temporary UI.
Do apply the pill radius to anything clickable or status-bearing, and the 4px radius to anything you read data inside of — no other radius value.
Do treat real data (sparklines, the composite chart, the ticker tape) as the page's visual anchor instead of decorative imagery.
donts: Don't introduce a dark mode or a black background — the light ledger-paper world is a deliberate, single-theme commitment.
Don't add drop shadows to permanent in-flow elements (cards, rows, panels).
Don't default to rounded-lg (8–16px) cards; the system has exactly two radii and both are already assigned.
Don't reach for a three-equal-column card grid for the stock list — it's a ledger table with a shared column grid, not a card grid.
Don't add gradients, glows, or glossy/3D abstract imagery — explicitly tried and rejected during this project for reading as generic AI-generated art.
